instruction.name: xvbitsel.v
instruction.description: Compute bitwise selection: for each bit position, if the bit in `c` equals to one, copy the bit from `b` to `dst`, otherwise copy from `a`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4

throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.98 cycles. The measured CPI 0.4975 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LASX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with integer vector operands. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
